title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཛ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 98)
shelf_note: Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka section volume 98 (dza), containing Ashvaghosha's Vajrasūcī refuting Brahminical caste arguments.

tr_errors_A.problem: Mistranslates the proper name of Sage Manu (ཤེད་ / Shed) as Shanti.
Mistranslates the proper name Dhṛtarāṣṭra (ཡུལ་འཁོར་འཛིན་) literally as a descriptive phrase.

tr_errors_A.english: the durva sacred grass in the flowing forest
tr_errors_A.problem: Omits the numeral 'nine' (དག) and misrenders the grove name as 'flowing forest'.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B accurately identifies and restores classical Sanskrit proper names (Sage Manu, Daśapura, Dhṛtarāṣṭra) that Translation A misinterprets.

book_verdict: A clean, well-preserved folio from the Madhyamaka section of the Derge Tengyur with flawless OCR transcription; Translation B provides an expert-quality rendering with correct classical names.
